Events contain only changes detected for mounitng positions and sensors.

For example for following list of events: |

1. Sensor 1 SPLOW (WARNING) DETECTED
2. Sensor 1 SBLOW (WARNING) DETECTED, Sensor 2: SPLOW (WARNING) DETECTED
3. Sensor 1 SPLOW SEVERITY_CHANGED (CRITICAL)
4. Sensor 2 SPHGH (WARNING)
5. Sensor 2 SPHGH SEVERITY_CHANGED (CRITICAL)

When consumed the final result are: |

- Sensor 1: SPLOW (CRITICAL), SBLOW (WARNING)

Restrictions:

- The events can be buffered and sent in chronological order.
- The chronological order of events are sent in the context of device.
- Outdated events and events with future time are ignored.

post.description:
This Webhook will push all the changes detected for issues, tasks and predictions except the ones generated by manual inspection.

Changes related to issues and tasks are only triggered when the severity changes.
Therefore, this webhook will NOT push every new telemetry received if these telemetries do not create an issue/task, update the severity of the issue/task or close the issue/task.

However, this webhook will push every new predicted values from the analytical layer EVEN IF these predicted values do not trigger the creation or update of an issue/task.

Also note that:

- The events can be buffered and sent in chronological order.
- The chronological order of events are sent in the context of device.
- Outdated events and events with future time are ignored.

For example, supposing the following list of events:

1. Sensor 1 SPLOW (WARNING) DETECTED
2. Sensor 1 SBLOW (WARNING) DETECTED, Sensor 2: SPLOW (WARNING) DETECTED
3. Sensor 1 SPLOW SEVERITY_CHANGED (CRITICAL)
4. Sensor 2 SPHGH (WARNING)
5. Sensor 2 SPHGH SEVERITY_CHANGED (CRITICAL)
6. Sensor 2 SPHGH RESOLVED

When the even is pushed, the final result will be: |

- Sensor 1: SPLOW (CRITICAL), SBLOW (WARNING)
- Sensor 2: SPLOW (WARNING)


 #### *NOTE*: *Please replace PATH with your webhook path and communicate it to the Tirematics Team.*

Get tire tread used for given locations or SAP account number LMD.
Either fleetLocationId or locationSAPNumberLmd is required in the request.
If the both are passed, then the results for both will be returned.

List of location Ids to return tread used.

Either **locationIdList** or **locationSAPNumberLmd** is required.

This API allows you to specify what other vehicles physically connected to the vehicle are.(e.g. tractor and trailer)
We refer to such connected vehicles as “Associated Vehicles.” 

Within this API, you can specify multiple Associated Vehicles for a single vehicle.
Currently, Associated Vehicle(s) are used in the following ways
- Display the vehicle and associated vehicle(s) together on Open Issue Report (refer to ReadMe article, https://dash.readme.com/project/tirematics/v4.0/docs/built-in-alert-channels) 
- Calculation of the “LOAD_COMPOSITE” of PredictionCode (refer to ReadMe article, https://docs.bridgestonedigital.com/tirematics/docs/prediction-codes)

Get an estimate of the potential fuel cost loss due to underiflation for a given location IDs.  

This API uses vehicle fuel efficiency rating (MPG), fuel type (gasoline etc) and reccomended pressure retrieved at the time of the vehicle creation.

To use Tirematics Fuel ecomnomy report API it is required to pass 2 digit alpha code for the state.

This model returns how many years, days, hours, minutes, and seconds ago the event occured (e.g. telemetry received, manual inspection conducted, issue created/resolved)

Example.

GIVEN  
  last date time telemetry was received from device is 10:30:01 Jan 20 2022 
IF
  Search Device API is called at 11:37:09, Jul 21 2023
THEN
  return object with 
    years = 1
    month = 6
    days = 1
    hours = 1
    minutes = 7
    seconds = 8.

getOemRecommendedPressure.description:
Set this property to TRUE if you are unable to provide target pressure for each axle.

If this property is set to TRUE then Tirematics will attempt to retrieve target pressures for each axle via a 3rd party API.

vin must be valid in order for the API call to be successful.

If this property is set to FALSE then Tirematics will use the values from the property recommendedAxlePressure.

muteAlert.description:
If a telemetry is received from this vehicle in a time range of between startDateTime and endDateTime, then the telemetry will be stored in OrphanTelemetry table in Tirematics and will not generate alerts, update the existing alert severity and close existing alerts of the vehicle. 
If either startDateTime or endDateTime is set to Null, then this will be NOT applicable.

startDateTime.description: Start date and time in UTC to mute alerts of the vehicle.

endDateTime.description: End date and time in UTC to mute alerts of the vehicle.

vehicleMobileNumber.description:
CAUTION: If this field is entered then all alerts associated with that vehicle will be sent via SMS to the number provided.
We recommend using the official Alert Reference API to create alert recipients.

urlTracker.description:
Used specifically for the URL link to Toolbox from the email alerts. 
Ignore this field if your referential system is not Toolbox.

syncTo.description:
This field is still supported but will be removed soon, since this field has been replaced by SyncToVehicles under Fleet Location GET/POST/PUT APIs.
If both of this syncTo field and the SyncToVehicle field provide diffrent value, then the latest one will overwrite the syncTo field in Tirematics.

This property is used when you want to sync this vehicle with other Bridgestone systems.
For synching with multiple systems, use comma separated values with no space between values(ToolBox,WEBFLEET).
Leave this properly null if you only need to sync to Tirematics only. Refer to ReadMe aritcle, https://docs.bridgestonedigital.com/tirematics/docs/syncto.

lastUpdateAt.description: Last time the record was updated (not in use for POST/PUT APIs).

fleetLocationReferenceSystem.description: Reference system of fleet location. Only applicable if reference system of vehicle is not the same as fleet location

deviceReferenceSystem.description: Reference system of device. Only applicable if reference system of device is different from vehicle

isActive.description: A vehicle flagged as 'IsActive = FALSE' is no longer in use. Users will not receive any Tirematics alerts for that vehicle. Vehicle is not deleted at the database level. In POST API, all vehicles are marked as TRUE by default.

isDeleted.description: A vehicle flagged as 'IsDeleted = TRUE' is no longer in use. Users will not receive any Tirematics alerts for that vehicle. Vehicle is 'soft' deleted at the database level. In POST API, all vehicles are marked as FALSE.

vehicleId.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle. Typically a database generated Id or GUID coming from the source system.

lastKnownLocation.description: This is the last known location of the vehicle at the time of the last telemetry received.

latitude.description: the latest latitude of vehicle geo-location

longitude.description: the latest longitude of vehicle geo-location

primaryNumber.description:
Vehicle license plate number.
Refer to secondaryNumber field for fleet internal number of any other sort of vehicle identity used by the customer.

secondaryNumber.description:
Fleet reference number or any other sort of vehicle identity used by the customer only.
Refer to primaryNumber field for license plate number.

alerts.description: This array includes problems codes tied to the vehicle

tirePositions.description: Details of Tire positions with its alert if any

problemCode.description: Code for the detected vehicle issue. See documentation guides for a full list of problem codes.

problemValue.description: Measurement value considered for issue creation

severity.description:
Severity level of the Task. There are 3 severity levels. 'Warning', 'Critical' and 'Catastrophic'
None = 0,
Catastrophic = 1,
Critical =2,
Warning = 3
With IsTracker option set to true on API call below severity value will return.
 Normal = 0
 Warning = 1
 Critical = 2

createdAt.description: UTC Date/time when the issue was created.

resolvedBy.description: Defines who resolved the issue (ex: API, Telemetry, User etc…)

taskCode.description:
A Task Code is genereated by a Problem Code or a combination of more than 1 Problem Codes.
A Task Code is the type of recommended operation to close the Problem Code(s).

category.description:
Enum describing which component the task is for:
1 = Sensor
2 = Tire
3 = Device
4 = Vehicle

classification.description:
Inidcates the type of task
1 = Descriptive
2 = Prescriptive
This property is not in use yet and is always hardcoded to 2.

recommendedValue.description:
This recommended value will change depending on the nature of the task.
For a low pressure event, it represents the target pressure. 
In case of a low tread depth, it represents the pull point. 
Refer to our Task and Problem Code documentation for more details.

actualValue.description:
This actual value will change depending on the nature of the task. 
For a low pressure event, it represents the cold adjusted measured pressure. 
In case of a low tread depth, it represents the actual minimum RTD measured. 
Refer to our Task and Problem Code documentation for more details.

problemCodes.description: List of problem codes to fix as an array

isFixed.description: Flag indicating if the task is fixed or not.

resolvedBy.description: Defines who resolved the task (ex: API, Telemetry, User etc…)

createdAt.description: UTC Date/time when the Task Code was created.

isRecurring.description: Flag indicating if the problem code is recurring or not.

estimatedCriticalDate.description:
Estimated date at which the tire pressure will cross the cirtical threshold for under inflation.
Only applies to problem code SPLOSS.

estimatedTimeToCritical.description:
Estimated hours at which the tire pressure will cross the cirtical threshold for under inflation.
Only applies to problem code SPLOSS.

VehiclePolicy.description: Object containing the different policies for the vehicle. It includes targets and thresholds for pressure, tread depth, temperature, frequency of inspections etc...

recommendedAxlePressure.description:
Recommended Pressure setting for each vehicle axle in bar with up to 5 decimal places.
This is the target pressure that tires mounted to the vehicle should be inflated to.
Each axle, from the front of the unit to the back, is delimited by a dash ""-"" sign.
For a 3 axle vehicles with a target pressure on steer of 8.12345 bar and a target pressure of 8 bar for drive axles, this field value would be 8.12345-8-8.

This field is required unless the property getOemRecommendedPressure is set to TRUE.

axlePressureLowWarningLimit.description: Threshold limit to determine SPLOW TPMS.DTO.VehicleManagement.ProblemCode - Warning Level

axlePressureLowCriticalLimit.description:
Threshold limit to determine under inflation of critical severity.
Same logic as above.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPLOW.

axlePressureLowCatastrophicLimit.description:
Threshold limit to determine under inflation of catastrophic severity.
Same logic as above.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPLOW.

axlePressureHighWarningLimit.description:
Threshold limit to determine over inflation of warning severity.
Same logic as above.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPHIGH.

axlePressureHighCriticalLimit.description:
Threshold limit to determine over inflation of critical severity.
Same logic as above.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPHIGH.

axlePressureHighCatastrophicLimit.description:
Threshold limit to determine over inflation of catastrophic severity.
Same logic as above.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPHIGH.

pressureDiffAcrossAxle.description:
Threshold limit for the variation of pressure between tires across the same axle. Returned in bar.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPAXLE.

pressureDiffDualFit.description:
Threshold limit for the variation of pressure between two tires in a dual assembly. Returned in bar.

Use in the calculation of the problem code SPDUAL.

axleTreadDepthLowWarningLimit.description:
Tread depth warning limit for each axle. Expressed in millimeters.
Each axle, from the front of the unit to the back, is delimited by a dash "-" sign.
A 3 axles vehicle with tread depth warning limit of 3 mm on Steer and 4 mm for the 2 drive axles would read: 3-4-4.

If this field value is not passed when the vehicle is created, then Tirematics will automatically add 2 mm to the critical limit for each axle.

Key property to determine LOWRTD. Refer to https://docs.bridgestonedigital.com/tirematics/docs/problem-codes.

recommendedPullPoints.description:
Tread depth critical limit for each axle. Expressed in millimeters.
Each axle, from the front of the unit to the back, is delimited by a dash "-" sign.
A 3 axles vehicle with tread depth critical limit of 3 mm on Steer and 5 mm for the 2 drive axles would read: 3-4-4.
Key property to determine LOWRTD <link to ProblemCode definition>"

axleTreadDepthLowCatastrophicLimit.description:
Tread depth catastrophic limit for each axle. Expressed in millimeters.
Each axle, from the front of the unit to the back, is delimited by a dash "-" sign.
A 3 axles vehicle with tread depth catastrophic limit of 1.6 mm on Steer and 1.6 mm for the 2 drive axles would read: 1.6-1.6-1.6
Key property to determine LOWRTD <link to ProblemCode definition>"

treadDepthDiffDualFit.description: Maximum tolerance for tread depth variation between tires in dual fitment. In millimeters.

treadDepthDiffAcrossAxle.description: Maximum tolerance for tread depth variation among tires across the same axle. In millimeters.

axleTemperatureHighCatastrophicLimit.description:
Threshold limit for the axle (in Celsius) to trigger a high temperature alert of catastrophic level.

Used in the calculation of the problem code STHIGH.

axleTemperatureHighCriticalLimit.description:
Threshold limit for the axle (in Celsius) to trigger a high temperature alert of critical level.

Use in the calculation of the problem code STHIGH.

axleTemperatureHighWarningLimit.description:
Threshold limit for the axle (in Celsius) to trigger a high temperature alert of warning level.

Use in the calculation of the problem code STHIGH.

acrossAxleTemperatureDifferenceLimit.description:
Maximum difference in Celsius between two axle ends of the same axle.

Use in the calculation of the problem code STAXLE.

noOfDaysVehicleNotSeen.description:
Minimum number of days between telemetries received from a given vehicle.

Use in the calculation of the problem code VMISS.
